visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, dressed in a white tank top and dark grey wide-leg trousers, sits on a small wooden bench in a bright department store. She smiles broadly and gestures with her hands while talking to a person in black standing to her left. The background includes an escalator and a TV screen displaying health slogans. (2) The woman mimics the action of riding a horse, extending her arms forward as if holding reins and bouncing slightly on the wooden bench. She laughs energetically with her eyes squinted in joy. The setting is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting, highlighting the clean retail environment and decorative orchids. (3) Following a cut, the woman is now seated on a long, beige upholstered sofa in the same furniture section. She looks around the store with a cheerful expression, resting her hands on the cushioned surface. The background features more furniture displays and shelves under soft, warm lighting. (4) The woman lies flat on her back on the beige sofa, laughing uncontrollably while stretching her arms. A large strawberry emoji overlay appears briefly over her chest. The camera remains static as she enjoys the comfort of the furniture, surrounded by other retail displays and polished wooden flooring.

By capturing the creator's genuine, high-energy laughter and humorous horse-riding demonstration, the content emphasizes that the furniture is not just functional but also a source of comfort and joy in a modern lifestyle context.
